name: Build and Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0' # Run at midnight every Sunday

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install setuptools wheel

      - name: Build package
        run: python setup.py sdist bdist_wheel

      - name: Create draft release
        id: create_release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          asset_name: ha-mcp-${{ github.sha }}.tar.gz
          file: dist/ha-mcp-${{ github.sha }}.tar.gz
          draft: true

  release:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install setuptools wheel

      - name: Upload assets
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          asset_name: ha-mcp-${{ github.sha }}.whl
          file: dist/ha-mcp-${{ github.sha }}.whl
          draft: false
          prerelease: true
          release_id: ${{ needs.build.outputs.create_release.id }}

      - name: Publish release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          asset_name: ha-mcp-${{ github.sha }}.tar.gz
          file: dist/ha-mcp-${{ github.sha }}.tar.gz

          prerelease: true
